card.name: Verb before percent of patients
card.fires_on: Verbs such as occurred, reported or led to right after an adverse reaction name, just before 'in' and a percentage of patients in a warnings or trial-results sentence.

modes.label: Occurred/reported before percent
modes.description: The verb 'occurred' or 'reported' follows a reaction name and precedes 'in X% of patients'.
modes.example: In Study 205 (RCC), diarrhea<< occurred>> in 81% of patients receiving

modes.label: Drug name before percent
modes.description: The last piece of a brand name, followed by 'in' and a small percentage of patients.
modes.example: Dermatologic adverse reactions led to permanent discontinuation of LIBTAY<<O>> in 0.2% of patients

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning 'representing' or 'represent', which suits a percentage of patients that follows.
card.plain: It fires on the verb that comes just before the share of patients who had a side effect.
